summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus by the Naiad nymph Polyxo — by lot the bride of Potamon son of Egyptus when the sons of Aegyptus married the Danaids at Argos.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Glaucippe sixth among the daughters of Danaus borne on Polyxo. When the twelve sons of Egyptus by Caliadne cast lots for the Polyxo maidens, Potamon drew Glaucippe. On the wedding night she received her father's dagger and, like her sisters, slew her bridegroom — Hyginus names the man she killed as Niauius rather than Potamon.
